desc:
🟢 HULK CITY SMASH 🟢
Are you ready to become the ultimate force of destruction? Step into the shoes of a powerhouse and turn a peaceful metropolis into your personal playground of chaos! In Hulk City Smash, the rules are simple: SMASH EVERYTHING. 💥

🏙️ HOW TO PLAY:
DESTROY: Punch, kick, and stomp through skyscrapers, cars, and everything in your path! 🏢🚗

EARN STARS: The more damage you cause, the more your Wanted Level rises! Can you reach the legendary 5-STAR status? ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

SURVIVE: Watch out! As your stars increase, the Police and Military will deploy everything from squad cars to heavy tanks to bring you down. 🚔🚁

Earn Rewards: Use your destruction points to unlock epic new Characters and customize your look with glowing Trails! 🌈✨

 your rampage? There’s only one way to find out...
